sentences.text: This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.82/2023 registered at Police Station Sadar Dungarpur, District Dungarpur, for offences under Sections 363, 366, 376 (2) of IPC and under Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner who is aged about 19 yrs is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Drawing attention of the Courts towards the statement of the prosecutrix [2024:RJ-JD:2622] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-16267/2023] who is aged about 16 years recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix during her statements has clearly stated that she voluntarily went to the house of the present petitioner on 14.03.2023.
Learned counsel further submitted that prosecutrix in her statements has not levelled any allegations of forcible sexual assault against present petitioner.

However, now the parties have decided to settled their disputes amicably in the spirit of Lok adalat.
Learned counsel submitted that in view of the aforesaid, the petitioner who is in judicial custody deserved to be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this court prima facie finds that the petitioner is aged about 19 years only.

This Court prima facie also finds that prosecutrix in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has clearly stated that she voluntarily went to the house of present petitioner and remained with him for more than one month and has not levelled allegations of forcible sexual assault therein.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Rakesh S/o Rajiya, Aged About 19 Years, arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.82/2023 registered at Police Station Sadar Dungarpur, District Dungarpur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other [2024:RJ-JD:2622] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-16267/2023] case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 80-AbhishekK/-
